description: Discharge the release contract before shipping. Checks 11 requirements against your finished markup — reduced-motion strategy, viewport, visible focus, 44px touch targets, alt text, form labels, no debug spew, no placeholder copy, the recorded manifest version, that every pattern you claim resolves, and that no heavy runtime downloads on the reduced-motion path — and returns each failure with the exact fix. Then returns the 7 browser-only passes (desktop/mobile render, alignment, visual critique, fast-scroll lifecycle, accessibility audit, cold route) as OUTSTANDING with the command that discharges each. Those are never marked pass: this tool does not run a browser and does not pretend to. FREE, no key required.

slugs.description: optional — every pattern slug/number the page uses. Defaults to any data-mm-pattern attributes found in the markup; each is checked against the live catalogue so a typo or a renamed slug is caught here rather than as a 404 in the customer's build.

name: verify_complete
